title: Return an average
prompt: Write `average`, which returns the average of two whole numbers as a float, so average(1, 2) is 1.5. solve returns average(a, b).
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> float:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> float:
	return (a + b) / 2
hint: Same trap as before: dividing two ints drops the decimals. Divide by a float.
